name: ATK_QB_QRY_CRITERIA
description: table for rule criterias defined based on which the Rule's/Query's sqlQuery is created

columns.name: CRITERIA_ID
columns.description: Primary key of this table.

columns.name: SEQUENCE_NUMBER
columns.description: The criteria of a particular parent have to be evaluated in a particular order. This ordering can be achieved using this sequnce number.

columns.name: CRITERIA_TYPE
columns.description: A Criteria can be one of the two types 'GROUP', or 'ITEM'. This column represents the type of the criteria.

columns.name: PARENT_ID
columns.description: Every criteria does have a parent. The parent can be a query or another criteria of type 'GROUP'. This column identifies the parent.

columns.name: PARENT_TYPE
columns.description: Every criteria does have a parent. The parent can be a query or another criteria of type 'GROUP'. This column identifies the type of the parent. The valid values are QUERY or GROUP.

columns.name: CONJUNCTION_OPERATOR
columns.description: The criteria which are logical expressions are generally sepereated by operators like 'AND', 'OR' etc. This column represents this conjucntion operator.

columns.name: LEFT_HAND_EXP_TYPE
columns.description: The product teams can have either an expression or an attribute on the left hand side of the expression. This column represents what is present on the left hand side of the criteria.

columns.name: OPERATION_NAME
columns.description: Defines the operation on Left hand side operands

columns.name: LHSLEFT_OPERAND_IDENTIFIER
columns.description: The identification number of the left operand in the left hand side expression.

columns.name: LHSLEFT_OPERAND_TYPE
columns.description: The data type  of the left operand in the left hand side expression.

columns.name: LHSLEFT_OPERAND_VS_FLAG
columns.description: This field is used to determine whether the left hand operand is associated to a valueset of not. If the value is 'Y' then the operand is associated to a valueset. If the value is 'N' the operand is not assocaited to a valueset.

columns.name: LHSRGHT_OPERAND_IDENTIFIER
columns.description: The identification number of the right operand in the left hand side expression.

columns.name: OPERATOR_CODE
columns.description: Represents the operator used in the expression.

columns.name: RHS_OPERAND_TYPE
columns.description: The right hand side of the expression can be either an 'OPERAND' or a 'LITERAL'. This column is used to identify the type of the right hand side of the expression.

columns.name: RHS_LITERAL_VALUE
columns.description: The literal value used in the right hand side of the expression.

columns.name: RHS_DATE_LITERAL_VALUE
columns.description: This holds a literal date value on the right hand side of the criteria.

columns.name: RHS_VALUESET_LITERAL_VALUE
columns.description: This column stores the literal value that the user has selected from the value set associated with the LHS left operand.

columns.name: RHS_VALUESET_NUMBER_VALUE
columns.description: This column stores the value that the user has selected from the value set of type number associated with the LHS left operand.

columns.name: RHS_VALUESET_DATE_VALUE
columns.description: This column stores the value that the user has selected from the value set of type date associated with the LHS left operand.

columns.name: RHS_NUMBER_LITERAL_VALUE
columns.description: This holds a literal number value on the right hand side of the criteria.

columns.name: RHS_OPERAND_IDENTIFIER
columns.description: The identification number of the operand in the right hand side expression.

columns.name: CASE_SENSITIVE_FLAG
columns.description: This column is used only when we are dealing with the operands of STRING type. If the value of this column is 'Y' then the operation should not take case into consideration. Otherwise the comparision should be case sensitive.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
